result.summary: Phase 3: Work Order Inventory Integration implemented. Moved inventory deduction from add-part time to WO completion time. When a work order reaches 'Completed' status, the system queries catalog-linked parts (part_id IS NOT NULL) and creates 'sale' inventory_movements with reference_type='work_order'. Graceful degradation via try/catch — errors are logged but don't block completion. Inventory cache tags (inventoryMovements, inventoryBalances) revalidated on both server and client sides.
